tests: Registry has45 games, exact entry paths and trustworthy version/chapters; no report or frozen mirror guesses
External, credential, script, escaped and unknown URLs cannot read/write recent storage
No records until an actual entry recorder writes; missing history is empty
Maximum five distinct games, newest first, repeated version replaces same game and exact path survives refresh
Stored metadata cannot forge names, URLs or progress; invalid/future records are filtered
Only the recent key is cleared; game saves, sound choices and return receipts are preserved
Read/write/remove failures are non-blocking, failed writes preserve previous bytes and later recovery works
Corrupt recent bytes never affect other keys; next actual visit can replace this isolated ledger
Recent and old return receipts preserve query/filter/limit plus optional visible anchor position
Stopped or retained entry visits stay honestly labelled and never imply a valid save
unit.method: Pure registry/storage/receipt fixtures; no gameplay or real-device claim

ordinaryUi.method: Ordinary page opening, native keyboard links/buttons, no injected visit records or game progress. This is an entry/navigation test, not replaying gameplay.

faultFixtures.method: Explicit browser fault fixtures, separate from ordinary page-opening evidence. No game progress or visit payload injection; storage seed was earned by earlier ordinary entry visits.

firstInsertionReturn.method: Fresh browser, native directory Enter and native game-header return. No history seed.

boundary: Local device/browser entry visits, not saves or cloud sync;390CSS is simulation; no per-game replay or human quality certification.
